description: Create five new client-facing React pages and wire all routes in AppRoutes.jsx. Depends on FEAT-001 (layout must exist and build cleanly) and FEAT-002 (endpoints must be ready). The existing ClientChatPage.jsx is NOT modified.
steps: Create frontend/src/pages/client/ClientDashboardPage.jsx. This replaces the current ClientPortalPage as the index route for /client. It is a summary dashboard. Sections: (1) Welcome banner: greeting with user.name, subtitle 'Therapy with [user.therapist.name]' if therapist is populated on the user object from useAuth(). (2) Therapist card: show user.therapist.name, user.therapist.title, an avatar circle with first letter, and a 'Message Therapist' button that does navigate('/client/chat'). (3) Recent sessions widget: calls GET /api/v1/sessions/mine, shows the 3 most recent as small cards with date + startTime + status badge (use Badge from '../../components/common/Badge' — variant='success' for completed, variant='warning' for scheduled, variant='danger' for cancelled). 'View all' link to /client/bookings. (4) Recent shared notes widget: calls GET /api/v1/notes/shared, shows the 2 most recent. 'View all' link to /client/notes. Loading skeleton: plain text 'Loading...' while fetching. Error: silent catch, show empty state. Uses: import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'; import api from '../../api/axios'; import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext'; import Badge from '../../components/common/Badge'; import { Calendar, MessageSquare, FileText, ChevronRight, HeartHandshake } from 'lucide-react'.

Create frontend/src/pages/client/ClientBookingsPage.jsx. Calls GET /api/v1/sessions/mine on mount. Shows a table/card list of all sessions sorted newest first. Each row shows: date, startTime–endTime, therapist name (from therapistId.name on the session), duration (minutes), status badge, paymentStatus badge. Status badge variants: scheduled=warning, completed=success, cancelled=danger, no_show=danger, in_progress=info (use teal-100 text-teal-700 for in_progress since Badge may not have an info variant — check Badge.jsx: it has success/warning/danger/default variants, so map in_progress to default). If meetingLink is set and session.status is 'scheduled', show a 'Join Session' anchor tag (target=_blank). Empty state: Calendar icon + 'No sessions found'. Loading: 'Loading your sessions...'. Uses: import api from '../../api/axios'; import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext'; import Badge from '../../components/common/Badge'; import { Calendar, Clock, Video, ExternalLink } from 'lucide-react'.

Create frontend/src/pages/client/ClientPaymentsPage.jsx. Calls GET /api/v1/payments/mine on mount. Shows a table/card list of all payments sorted newest first. Each row: invoiceNumber (or 'Pending' if null), session date (from sessionId.date), amount formatted as currency (amount/100 with INR symbol ₹, since the backend stores paise), status badge (captured=success, created=warning, failed=danger, refunded=default), a 'View Invoice' button that opens /client/invoice/:paymentId in a new tab if status is captured. Empty state: CreditCard icon + 'No payment records found'. Loading: 'Loading payment history...'. Note: amount is stored in paise (smallest unit), so divide by 100 for display. Uses: import api from '../../api/axios'; import Badge from '../../components/common/Badge'; import { CreditCard, Receipt, ExternalLink } from 'lucide-react'.

Create frontend/src/pages/client/ClientNotesPage.jsx. Calls GET /api/v1/notes/shared on mount. Displays all shared notes as cards (same card design as the current ClientPortalPage shared notes section — copy that pattern). Each card: title, date, body text in a preformatted block (whitespace-pre-line), session date chip if sessionId is populated. Empty state: FileText icon + 'No shared notes yet' + subtext. Loading: 'Loading shared notes...'. Uses: import api from '../../api/axios'; import { FileText, Calendar } from 'lucide-react'.

Create frontend/src/pages/client/ClientProfilePage.jsx. Two-section layout: (1) Profile info form: GET /api/v1/clients/profile on mount, prefill form fields: name (text input), phone (text input). Emergency contact group: emergencyContactName, emergencyContactPhone, emergencyContactRelation (all text inputs from intakeData). Save button calls PUT /api/v1/clients/profile with { name, phone, intakeData: { emergencyContactName, emergencyContactPhone, emergencyContactRelation } }. On success, call updateUser({ name, phone }) from useAuth() to sync the auth context. Show success toast as a green inline banner 'Profile updated successfully' for 3 seconds. (2) Therapist info (read-only card): therapistId.name, therapistId.title from the profile API response. Password change note: 'To change your password, use the Forgot Password link on the login page.' Uses: import api from '../../api/axios'; import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext'; import { UserCircle, Phone, User, Shield, Save } from 'lucide-react'. Form state: useState for each field, initialized from API response in useEffect.

Update frontend/src/routes/AppRoutes.jsx. Import the five new pages: import ClientDashboardPage from '../pages/client/ClientDashboardPage'; import ClientBookingsPage from '../pages/client/ClientBookingsPage'; import ClientPaymentsPage from '../pages/client/ClientPaymentsPage'; import ClientNotesPage from '../pages/client/ClientNotesPage'; import ClientProfilePage from '../pages/client/ClientProfilePage'. Also keep the existing imports for ClientPortalPage and ClientChatPage. In the /client Route block, change the index route from ClientPortalPage to ClientDashboardPage. Add the four new child routes: <Route path='bookings' element={<ClientBookingsPage />} />, <Route path='payments' element={<ClientPaymentsPage />} />, <Route path='notes' element={<ClientNotesPage />} />, <Route path='profile' element={<ClientProfilePage />} />. Keep <Route path='chat' element={<ClientChatPage />} />. Remove the old ClientPortalPage import if not used elsewhere (it is not used elsewhere after this change).
acceptance_criteria: cd frontend && npm run build exits 0 with no errors
Navigating to /client shows the Dashboard with welcome banner and therapist card
Navigating to /client/bookings shows the sessions list (empty state if no sessions)
Navigating to /client/payments shows the payments list (empty state if no payments)
Navigating to /client/notes shows shared notes (empty state if none)
Navigating to /client/profile shows the profile form pre-filled from API; saving shows success banner
All six sidebar nav links in ClientLayout navigate to the correct route
verification: cd frontend && npm run build — must exit 0 with no errors
findings: All 5 pages created and AppRoutes.jsx updated. Build succeeded (vite v6.4.3, 2451 modules, exit 0). Chunk size advisory warning present (bundle 1320 kB) — not an error, expected for lucide-react. Badge variant 'neutral' used for in_progress sessions (Badge has no info variant). ClientPortalPage import removed from AppRoutes.
